title: Reviewing Grant for Families to Hire Foreign Domestic Workers for Care of Disabled Elderly
what_it_is: Reviewing Grant for Families to Hire Foreign Domestic Workers for Care of Disabled Elderly

sections.label: Foreign Domestic Worker Grant and levy
sections.summary: The FDW Grant, introduced in 2012, gives $120 monthly; the concessionary levy fell from $120 to $60 from May 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Foreign Domestic Worker (FDW) Grant was introduced in 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It provides a monthly grant of $120 to support households who need to hire FDWs to care for seniors and persons with moderate disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We do not have plans to increase the grant quantum at the moment, as the current grant quantum is generally adequate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The concessionary levy was lowered from $120 to $60 per month from May 2015, compared to the normal levy of $265 per month.

sections.label: FDW Grant households and amounts
sections.summary: About 6,200 households received the grant as of December 2015, and at least 10,400 households have benefited since 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As of December 2015, about 6,200 households are receiving the grant, with the Government providing a total grant amount of $8.4 million in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since 2012, at least 10,400 households have benefited from this grant, with the Government grant totalling $20.6 million.

sections.label: Net subsidy and levy plans
sections.summary: Families get a net subsidy of $60, and there are no plans to further reduce or tier the concessionary levy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With the lowered concessionary levy of $60, families who need to hire FDWs to care for their frail elderly or persons with moderate disabilities will receive a net subsidy of $60, taking into account the monthly FDW Grant of $120.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In view of that, we currently do not have plans to further reduce the FDW concessionary levy or to tier it based on an age criterion.
